allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Basis of Allotment-Right Issue

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of International Securities Identification Number ( ISIN ) for the rights entitlements to be credited for the purpose of Rights Issue.'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on March 11, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 14091896 : 14091896, i.e 14091896 Equity Shares for every 14091896 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 10 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on December 18, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 15000000 : 14090896, i.e 15000000 Equity Shares for every 14090896 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 10 per share.
